content: Aaradhya Verma contacted insurance agent Neha Kapoor to inquire about a 15% premium increase on her health policy renewal and asked about alternative plan options. Neha explained the increase was due to new benefits and rising medical costs, offering an alternative plan with a lower premium but higher deductible, and shared its brochure. Aaradhya requested time to review the alternative plan details, asked about the renewal deadline (end of the month), and inquired about the active status of her current policy.

action_items: Aaradhya Verma to review the alternative plan brochure
Renew policy by the end of the month
